prompt: In a video game you earn $50$ coins per level plus a one-time $20$-coin bonus, so your coins are $50L + 20$ after $L$ levels. How many coins do you have after $4$ levels?
hint: The formula already describes your coins. You only need to use the number of levels the question gives.

hints.text: The formula already describes your coins. You only need to use the number of levels the question gives.
Put $4$ in place of $L$ to get $50(4) + 20$. Multiply first, then add the bonus.
$50 \times 4 = 200$ and $200 + 20 = 220$, so you have $220$ coins after $4$ levels.

explanation: The question asks about $4$ levels, so substitute $L = 4$ into the formula to get $50(4) + 20$.
Multiplication comes before addition in the order of operations, so work out $50 \times 4 = 200$ first.
Then add the one-time bonus: $200 + 20 = 220$, so you have $220$ coins.
